correctness.rationale: Every rank n-1 isotone map of a finite n-chain is uniquely determined by adjacent collapsed kernel indices i,i+1 and omitted image value t. The explicit piecewise J_n maps (i,t) to (t-1,i) if t>=i+2, to (t,i+1) if t<=i-1, otherwise fixes it; the outer branches reverse one another. For its mate (j,u), both u in {i,i+1} and t in {j,j+1}, which are precisely the crossed image-kernel transversal conditions for mutual inverse maps. Fixed points occur iff t=i or i+1 and are exactly the idempotents, hence 2(n-1) fixed and (n-1)(n-2)/2 two-cycles, including n=2. Independent direct composition verified 240 maps for n=2..9; the all-n proof is structural rather than extrapolated.

value.rationale: The rank n-1 D class is the maximal nonbijective layer of the natural order-preserving transformation monoid. An explicit idempotent-fixing mutual-inverse involution with exact cycle decomposition gives a constructive infinite-family strengthening of whole-monoid permutation-matching existence on this distinguished layer. The claim does not purport to solve the still broader whole-monoid involution problem.
